newsitem.title: UK: LME nickel hit by fresh selling, others nervous.
newsitem.headline: LME nickel hit by fresh selling, others nervous.

text.p: LME nickel lost more ground on Friday after a midday rebound petered out and investment funds renewed an onslaught of selling.
Three months nickel moved into the plus column in the early afternoon as trade buying absorbed selling by the funds.
But when the move higher stalled, the funds resumed liquidating positions, triggering stops below $7,500 per tonne.
The market finished the afternoon kerb burdened with $160 of losses at $7,470, $20 above its low.
"It keeps finding trade buying at the lows so it hasn't been accelerating down as it might have done," said analyst Martin Squires of Rudolf Wolff.
